title: Paper-1 v03r end-to-end organism canary v1f
summary: Preserve the narrow v03r canary while repairing every blocker accepted by the v1e adjudication: replace wildcard and duplicated dependencies with one canonical exact file-edge registry; add a direct nonrecursive HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop; split pre-review P1CB10 mechanism evidence from post-review transition evidence; register all 48 conditional LoRA opportunities before fitting while withholding dispatch until both fidelity gates pass; disclose THINK0 as exact-endpoint-cued; split final-goal from donor/backend visibility; restrict review evidence to operator-enforced self-declared/unverified metadata; and use only selected-cue training-set-resubstitution wording. The cognitive mechanism, call ceilings, and P1CB01 through P1CB10 identities are unchanged.
system_thesis: Before testing learned LOOP policy, rank pyramids, long lifetimes, or base promotion, determine whether one frozen and explicitly game-scaffolded resolver can convert dispersed public action outcomes into fallibly self-reviewed typed connections, use those connections under a later exact-endpoint-cued goal, and achieve immediate candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition on selected repeatedly trained cues through two isolated per-life LoRAs, without an exact cognitive verifier or outcome-selected corpus.

nodes.before: Public v03r records had no canary-specific closed cognitive projection.

nodes.rationale: Bind experience and every outcome-relevant public transform without private-compatible fields or duplicated E/M evidence.

nodes.before: v1b treated a provisional proposal as a mutable memory row.
nodes.after: DREAM creates an immutable audit proposal; one blind model SELF_CHECK either creates one immutable SUPPORTED row or no cognitive row.
nodes.rationale: Preserve false self-approval while eliminating status mutation and semantic verification.

nodes.before: v1b recurrence pools, counters, seeds, and states were not machine-unique.
nodes.after: One exact 46-WAKE/22-REACTIVATE/16-SLEEP prefix and matched sixteen-slot OWN/DIST branches use closed states and branch-local deterministic selectors.

nodes.before: Text and LoRA returned incomparable or provenance-bearing objects.
nodes.after: THINK0/THINK1 operate for at most twelve opportunities and receive one closed H-handle semantic read projection independent of backend provenance.

nodes.before: v1b goal timing was circular and DIST/path/sham could depend on forbidden or wrong data.
nodes.after: Public DIST seals pre-goal; role/causal candidates and unique matched sham seal after goal but before any T output; correctness is offline only.
nodes.rationale: Causally test realized memory content without selecting generation or repairs by result.

nodes.before: Candidate-to-row reconstruction and fit execution were selectable.
nodes.after: Exactly two pristine per-life rank-64 fits use four exact view families, every legal question index, one shared host-enumerated two-backend candidate roster, deterministic updates, two complete 48-case fidelity sets, and atomic mounts.

nodes.before: v1b review objects and validity routing were prose-level and P1CB01 straddled implementation.
nodes.after: Ratification releases CPU only; exact packets, separately requested role-labelled reviewer and advocate dispositions, and closed authority tokens gate DEV, T, L, and terminal. Persisted records are explicitly self-declared and unverified rather than platform attestations.
nodes.rationale: Require an external human witness release, changed-byte rereview, and registered GPU authority as project procedure while recording only SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED role metadata; these bytes do not authenticate identity, freshness, independence, non-fabrication, or anti-self-certification.

nodes.before: v1d still contained mutually contradictory reducer, identity-domain, opportunity-lifecycle, terminal-claim, matrix, and review-evidence bytes.
nodes.after: One canonical sorted exact-filename file-edge registry, mechanically derived nonnormative endpoint views, and one opportunity-ledger schema bind every dependency, ordering, validity class, fixed prospective DREAM/SELF_CHECK pair, and condition/state/reason mapping; wildcards, duplicated normative edge views, unlisted, multiple, or contradictory semantics fail pre-dispatch.
nodes.rationale: Make implementation a transcription of ratified semantics rather than an outcome-relevant design choice.

nodes.before: Terminal-review rejection, invalidity, role overlap, or terminal-artifact failure had no finite nonrecursive route to HUMAN_TERMINAL.
nodes.after: Every terminal-review or terminal-artifact failure changes control state directly to HUMAN_TERMINAL with zero further dispatch, review, retry, authority token, or scientific report; a best-effort human-terminal-stop receipt records available evidence but receipt-write failure cannot recurse or reopen execution.
nodes.rationale: Close the stage machine even when the mechanism responsible for reviewing or recording a terminal itself fails.

claims.before: No v03r recurrent organism had an exact prospective causal memory-use test.
claims.after: A green T supports only that this exact game-specific ontology- and proof-sequence-scaffolded system completed a final-question/animal/answer-withheld but exact-endpoint-cued THINK0-to-return-write feedback loop and structurally used offline-correct life-local content in later reasoning on one aligned seed-5 pair under registered readers. The cue source and target equal the later final-goal endpoints, making this coached relevance construction rather than autonomous relevance discovery. Public actions were environment-generated and the model committed only a final answer token, so this is not evidence of action improvement or online action learning.

claims.before: Candidate recognition was not safely mapped back to thinker-visible semantics.

Each set is twelve selected M1_OWN training rows crossed with the same four repeatedly trained view families; the host pre-resolves query cardinality and supplies one shared answer-bearing two-backend roster per concrete cue. This is not unseen recall, preservation, text equivalence, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, RAG comparison, generalization, or superiority evidence.

acceptance_tests.setup: After ratification, validate every protocol/source/executable hash, scope, ceiling, stage dependency, review object, authority transition, schema resource, every exact tuple in the sole canonical file-edge registry, every mechanically derived endpoint view, and every row of the canonical opportunity-ledger mapping. Exercise missing, extra, duplicate, asymmetric, nonfilename, wildcard, category-mismatch, stale-view, and direct-terminal-base-case negatives.
acceptance_tests.expected: The exact file registry, derived views, context inventory, object/order/validity/ledger bindings, and exactly P1CB01 through P1CB10 have set equality. Only CPU to externally witnessed reviewed 216-call DEV to externally witnessed reviewed 632-call T to conditional two-fit L to HUMAN_TERMINAL is reachable; seed-generic DEV through index 48 is legal; every contradictory or unlisted normative byte fails closed; every terminal-review failure reaches the direct out-degree-zero fail-stop without recursive review; P1CB01 never blocks CPU implementation itself.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The canary is one immutable finite staged experiment with one executable interpretation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Holding the disclosed exact THINK0 source/target endpoints and missing-join agenda fixed, independently mutate every withheld final-animal, rendered-question, answer, intervention-truth, private-factorization, result, audit/prose/counter, donor/backend, and provenance field; separately mutate endpoint cues, authorized final reveal, concrete roster bindings, and the registered focus treatment.
acceptance_tests.expected: Before authorized reveal, every rendered/tokenized request and durable descendant is byte-inert to all withheld and donor/backend mutations, while a registered endpoint-cue mutation changes only its allowlisted descendants and a registered focus mutation changes only its branch. Missing, swapped, wrong, or reused cue rosters are rejected. The construct report explicitly records endpoint equality and coached missing-join relevance rather than claiming target absence or autonomous relevance discovery.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Registered taint behavior is exact: the disclosed endpoint agenda is the only pre-reveal final-goal derivative, and no answer-equivalent, donor/backend, audit, provenance, or roster side channel exists.

acceptance_tests.setup: Golden and adversarial-test every kind, event-to-row projection, proposal/check combination, duplicate ancestry, lineage, depth, conflict, cycle, and hash, including interleaved premise/support citation vectors and exactly-one-branch SOURCE_VALUE/ANIMAL_VALUE rows in DREAM and SELF_CHECK.
acceptance_tests.expected: Accepted citations always preserve emitted premises then supplied support-row order with first-occurrence dedup; valid witnessed row kinds validate exactly once; only witnessed or structurally model-supported immutable rows enter cognition, without semantic verifier, mutation, retry, or audit leakage.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Memory admission and provenance reduction are deterministic and honestly fallible.

acceptance_tests.falsifies: Registered candidate-constrained backend comparisons isolate mounted content without host path transfer.

acceptance_tests.setup: Match the complete 31-predictor vector and masks; seal NO_MEMORY, GOLD_TEXT, and GOLD_TWIN on six exact DEV lives; verify exact seed-0/1/2 public-projection and vocabulary hashes at actual counts through index 48 and unchanged seed-5 vectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every registered DEV life has one legal contiguous sole-projector output with no fixture-local mapper, truncation, alias gap, or heldout drift; shortcuts stay below threshold; both gold arms solve 3/3 with required G handles; NO_MEMORY is below 3/3; all 216 opportunities reconcile.

acceptance_tests.setup: Use deterministic fake providers across the common exact 46/22/16 prefix, proposal admission, THINK0, M0 zero return, and matched sixteen-slot OWN/DIST return branches, including seeds, selectors, op-12, and non-dispatch cases.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every state, seed, counter, owner, row, handle, and ledger record matches; M1_OWN is fixed without results. Evidence is limited to executability and the goal-routed return intervention after a shared recurrent prefix.

acceptance_tests.setup: On seed-5 twins, seal public projections, goal, vocabulary, DIST, candidates, path/sham, and all T plans in registered order; run every prospectively runnable trace and score only after seals.
acceptance_tests.expected: Missing roots is a valid mechanism negative. Sham infeasibility is only VALID_STAGE_FAILURE/SHAM_NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: the other five arms run, T-SHAM emits exact zero-attempt rows, and no full or weakened causal-use claim passes. Otherwise the complete pre-registered feedback, own/donor, path, sham, structural-use, accounting, and review conjunction is required.

acceptance_tests.setup: After externally witnessed reviewed T-pass authority and before either fit or fidelity request, seal all 48 conditional THINK1_LORA IDs, lives, arms, slots, seeds, and denominator in REGISTERED_NOT_DISPATCHABLE state. Run exactly two pristine fixed-corpus fits; for each, score twelve selected M1_OWN training rows crossed with the same four repeatedly trained view families under host pre-resolution and one prospectively cue-bound shared answer-bearing roster; then either authorize atomic own/donor mounts after both independent fidelity gates or emit the complete fidelity-failure non-dispatch vector.
acceptance_tests.expected: Late, dynamic, result-selected, deleted, rekeyed, missing, or partly authorized registrations fail closed. Joint fidelity pass changes all 48 opportunities to DISPATCH_AUTHORIZED and each adapter independently reaches 44/48 before registered own/donor paths, isolation, accounting, and structural-use tests run. Either fidelity failure leaves all 48 undispatchable and emits exactly one zero-attempt NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FIDELITY_FAILURE/NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE/FIDELITY_GATE_FAILED row per ID. Evidence is only immediate selected-cue candidate-constrained training-set-resubstitution recognition, never unseen or open recall, preservation, text equivalence, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, RAG comparison, generalization, or superiority.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Useful fixed corpora remain immediately candidate-recognizable through exactly two isolated per-life adapters on the registered training-derived resubstitution cues.

acceptance_tests.setup: Validate one canonical ledger schema and exhaustive unique condition/state/reason vectors for all 896 potential opportunities, including the 232 pre-registered DREAM/SELF_CHECK pairs; all 48 Stage-T-authorized, pre-fit REGISTERED_NOT_DISPATCHABLE LoRA opportunities; PASS/invalid/duplicate companion non-dispatch; precondition, authority, fidelity, trace terminal, model failure, infrastructure invalidity, stage failure; partial direct-fail-stop reconciliation; and terminal claim-state reconciliation.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every registered opportunity has exactly one mapped effect; companion registry membership is invariant to DREAM output; ineligible checks have the exact zero-attempt cause row; fidelity failure maps every one of the already registered 48 LoRA opportunities to its required zero-attempt vector; stage failures use NON_DISPATCH_STAGE_FAILURE, trace-local terminals use NON_DISPATCH_POST_TERMINAL only where legal, and every normative consumer is byte-identical. Missing, late, extra, dynamically appended, deleted, rekeyed, partly authorized, multiply mapped, retried, fake, or partial rows fail.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported outcomes correspond to one fixed prospective runtime and compute accounting envelope.

acceptance_tests.setup: At every transition and terminal, construct an immutable pre-review packet containing only the P1CB10 mechanism/fixture receipt; externally request separate fresh-context reviewer and advocate responses over that identical packet; persist only hash-bound SELF_DECLARED_UNVERIFIED role-labelled records; require explicit external-operator witness release; then construct a post-review transition receipt and final two-phase manifest outside the reviewed packet. Exercise future-digest, retroactive insertion, role-overlap, no-witness, malformed/missing disposition, changed-byte, terminal-review-failure, and receipt-write-failure vectors.
acceptance_tests.expected: Schema validity proves only formatting and hash binding. Self-declared records alone never advance a stage. Any missing external witness release, rejection, overlap, changed byte, or malformed evidence takes the direct nonrecursive HUMAN_TERMINAL fail-stop; every result terminates. Reports state that artifacts do not authenticate actor identity, context freshness, substantive independence, or non-fabrication. The linter rejects invented platform attestation, unrealized positive-stage facts, ambiguous keyword negation, recurrence-as-a-whole, generic construction, generalization, action improvement, online or continued learning, unseen/open recall, whole-corpus storage, durability, capacity, scale, superiority, text/LoRA equivalence, autonomous relevance discovery, Paper-1-headline language, and negative-result overlocalization.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The registered externally witnessed review procedure, changed-byte rereview rule, direct fail-stop, two-phase evidence ordering, and claim firewall are executable without treating unauthenticated review metadata as scientific evidence.
